rationale: The fresh pool produced 36 exact fingerprints with no dominant declared structure. The bounded shortlist preserves eight materially different commercial mechanisms and control points: confirmed-cash recovery, field-evidence-to-invoice release, regulated post-market evidence, installer-channel energy analytics, local-first research-data custody, connected-device data-access infrastructure, commission revenue assurance, and merchant return-loss control. Delayed history was used only after deduplication: exact or near-exact repeats in accounting-firm KSeF exception handling, equal-value job mapping, supplier compliance passports, appointment-slot recovery, EUDAMED record assembly, and battery-passport custody were not selected. Selected historical relatives materially change payer, paid event, control point, or distribution route, and their remaining objections are assigned for direct research rather than presumed resolved.
